image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on sandy ground in front of dry, greyish brush. The rabbit has speckled grey-brown fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears with dark tips. Its white fluffy tail is visible at the rear. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows.
